main_text.p: sponsum fusum exspecto : ne homo iste cristas nimis erigat, & se victorem apud suos jactitet. Mihi quidem videtur nihil novi afferre; sed flare eadem, calidiore quodam spiritu : idq; arroganter. Sed de his tuum, clarissime Luci, judicium exspecto. Facies Deo & Ecclefiæ rem gratissimam; si hominem istum, doctâ & solidâ tuâ confutatione, confuderis & pudefeceris. Me autem, tui observantissimum, ama; & bene vale. Altorfio, 11, Decembris, Anno 1609.

page.notes: Left margin shows cut-off running text of the previous page (fragments such as "Doct", "hominis", "argu", "facit"), not transcribed. The printed text is set in italic and roman mixed; the long s is written as s. Some letters in the top lines are faint. The "Tui observantiss." and "Adamus Plancus." lines are set in larger type and treated as paragraphs. The ornament below the text is a printer's flower, not text.
